nodes.description: Obesity-related insulin resistance travels with fatty liver, dyslipidaemia and low adiponectin. Insulin resistance from insulin-receptor dysfunction travels with none of them, and insulin resistance from AKT2 dysfunction phenocopies the obesity pattern. SHORT syndrome sits with the receptor group: four of five studied patients had extreme insulin resistance without dyslipidaemia or hepatic steatosis, and adiponectin was preserved in three of those four. nodes.description: Where a single agent is not enough, published practice is to stack oral agents with complementary mechanisms rather than move to insulin - which matters here, because insulin resistance of this severity makes injected insulin both unattractive and only partly effective. In the reported case, metformin, an SGLT-2 inhibitor, a sulfonylurea, a thiazolidinedione and a GLP-1 agonist together took HbA1c from 14% to 8.8% in six months and then to 7.4%, and deferred insulin. Two of those classes are worth identifying separately: the SGLT-2 inhibitor lowers glucose by a renal route that does not depend on the impaired PI3K arm at all, and the GLP-1 agonist acts on the incretin axis that the knock-in mouse shows to be defective in this disease.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in PIK3R1 cause SHORT syndrome.
evidence.snippet: Our findings show that PIK3R1 mutations are the major cause of SHORT syndrome and suggest that the molecular mechanism of disease might involve downregulation of the PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway.

nodes.description: Anterior segment dysgenesis of the Axenfeld-Rieger type; the "R" of the acronym. Associated anterior chamber findings include posterior embryotoxon and glaucoma.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical reappraisal of SHORT syndrome with PIK3R1 mutations: toward recommendation for molecular testing and management.
evidence.snippet: Anterior chamber defects and insulin resistance or diabetes were also observed but were not as prevalent.

evidence.reference_title: SHORT syndrome with partial lipodystrophy due to impaired phosphatidylinositol 3 kinase signaling.
evidence.snippet: short stature, progeroid face, and Rieger anomaly (SHORT syndrome)

nodes.description: Sensorineural deafness, a minor feature but one that drives a specific surveillance recommendation.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical reappraisal of SHORT syndrome with PIK3R1 mutations: toward recommendation for molecular testing and management.
evidence.snippet: thin wrinkled skin, speech delay, sensorineural deafness

nodes.description: Postnatal growth restriction, continuous with the prenatal deficit; the "S" of the acronym.

evidence.reference_title: Clinical reappraisal of SHORT syndrome with PIK3R1 mutations: toward recommendation for molecular testing and management.
evidence.snippet: included intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) <10th percentile, postnatal growth restriction

nodes.description: Part of the characteristic facial gestalt, together with a small chin, thin lips, a downturned mouth and low-set posteriorly rotated ears. The gestalt is one of the features most consistently present in molecularly confirmed patients.

evidence.reference_title: A novel PIK3R1 mutation of SHORT syndrome in a Chinese female with diffuse thyroid disease: a case report and review of literature.
evidence.snippet: a characteristic facial gestalt (e.g. triangular face with a small thin, thin lip, downturned mouth, low-set posteriorly rotated ears, prominent forehead, underdeveloped or thin nasal alae as well as wrinkles)

evidence.reference_title: Clinical reappraisal of SHORT syndrome with PIK3R1 mutations: toward recommendation for molecular testing and management.
evidence.snippet: lipoatrophy and the characteristic facial gestalt

nodes.description: Hypoplastic or thin alae nasi, a recurrent component of the progeroid craniofacial appearance.

evidence.reference_title: SHORT Syndrome: Systematic Appraisal of the Medical and Dental Phenotype.
evidence.snippet: Individuals have a distinct progeroid craniofacial appearance with a triangular face, frontal bossing, hypoplastic or thin alae nasi, large low-set ears, and mandibular retrognathia.
